messages.subject: SRMR problem with lavaan.mi function
parts:
Hi,

I've encountered a rather bizarre problem using lavaan.mi function.

I've estimated my SEM model using ML as the estimator and used FIML to deal with missing data (30% drop-out between two study waves). Most of the fit statistics indicated good fit (including the later problematic SRMR, which was <0.05), except a significant Chi-square. 

Since the multivariate distribution of my observed variables is not normal, I've run an analysis using lavaan.mi (100 imputations) so that I can use MLM as the estimator. Now, the Chi-square was non-significant, CFI and RMSEA again indicated good fit... but, SRMR of 0.35 (!) indicated a serious issue with the model. I've tried outputting raw residuals - and they indeed looked awful, BUT the output also suggests that the means of the observed variables are 0, which can not be, as the mean structure was estimated. Furthermore, when trying to output standardized residuals, I get an error message stating that they can not be computed as "there are no free parameters in the model".

Any idea on how to proceed?

Thanks,
Helena
